npcs.name: Classmate
lines: Did you catch that last slide? I got distracted. What's living in that house actually like?
Could I borrow your notes after class? I'll get you a coffee.
returningLines: Saved you a seat. How are things at the house?

npcs.name: Dalia
lines: Window seat's free, if you're quick.
You look like someone who needs cake.
Sit, sit. I'll bring the usual.
returningLines: Back again? Your usual, then.
Oh, it's you. Bring someone nice next time.
You came with {b} last time. Just saying.

npcs.name: Yossi
lines: Bag? ...No bag.
Hot or cold?
Points card. No? Okay.
returningLines: Back again. Pita's still warm, if you want one.
Your housemate bought the last malabi. Sorry.
Same time as yesterday. Interesting.

npcs.name: Daniel
lines: Maya. Hey. I was in town, so...
You look good. The city suits you.
returningLines: We keep running into each other.
Tell your housemates I said hi. Or don't.

npcs.name: Yael Azulay
lines: Ron, Mom asked if you are eating.
Did you tell them about the restaurant yet?
returningLines: It's me again. Don't hang up.
Mom says the shop's landlord called.

npcs.name: Chef Eli
lines: You're late. Apron. Go.
Again. Faster. Good.
returningLines: The new one's back. Don't burn anything.
You've gotten quicker. Don't let it go to your head.

npcs.name: Mr. Sasson
lines: Some of us sleep, you know.
Your trash is out on the wrong day. Again.
returningLines: You again. ...Thank you for the shakshuka last time.
Quieter this week. Good.

npcs.name: Itai
lines: Any requests? I know four songs.
Coins for the guitar, wisdom for free.
returningLines: My favorite audience member!
Your friend with the teal hair played with me last week. Talented.

npcs.name: Neta
lines: The backyard still squeaks. Of course it does.
When I lived here, we had a rule about the bath. Do you still?
returningLines: Couldn't stay away. How's everyone?
I brought wine. For the drama.

npcs.name: Shai's mother
lines: Shai, my friend's daughter is still waiting for you to call.
Your father won't say it, but he worries.
returningLines: I'm calling again because you didn't call me.
Have you met anyone in that house? Anyone at all?

npcs.name: Roni
lines: Your engagement rate is... interesting. Let's talk.
We love authenticity. Can you send the analytics?
returningLines: Still waiting on those analytics, Kai.
The numbers don't quite match the vibe, do they?

npcs.name: Samir
lines: Spicy? Ask first, that is my rule.
Sit. Fresh falafel takes a minute.
returningLines: Your usual? I remember.
Bring your housemates next time.
